title: Search multiple locations for required objects
description: Use when a task requires finding multiple instances of the same object type.
content: When collecting multiple identical objects, do not assume they are all in one place. Search different receptacles and surfaces systematically, and pick up each object as soon as it is found to keep track of progress.

source.task_query: Your task is to: find two toiletpaper and put them in drawer.

title: Retry failed take actions after examining the location
description: Use when a take action fails despite the object being visible in the observation.
content: If a take action returns "Nothing happens," examine the location to confirm the object is still there, then retry the take action. The failure may be transient, and a subsequent attempt can succeed.

source.task_query: Your task is to: find two toiletpaper and put them in drawer.

title: Move only the object currently held
description: Use when placing an object into a container after picking up a new object.
content: After picking up a new object, the previously held object is no longer in your inventory. Move only the currently held object to the target container, and verify the container contents to confirm which objects have already been placed.

source.task_query: Your task is to: find two toiletpaper and put them in drawer.

title: Locate target objects by systematically examining containers
description: Use when the target object is not visible on surfaces and needs to be found in storage containers.
content: When searching for an object like a soapbar, check drawers and other storage containers by examining them one by one. The object may be hidden inside a closed or unexamined container, so systematically inspect nearby containers until the target is found.

source.task_query: Your task is to: clean some soapbar and put it in cabinet.

title: Clean objects at a sink basin before placing them
description: Use when a task requires cleaning an object before moving it to a destination.
content: To clean an object, first pick it up, then go to a sink basin and use the clean action with the sink basin. The sink basin does not need to contain visible items for the cleaning action to succeed.

title: Open closed cabinets before placing items inside
description: Use when the destination cabinet is closed and you need to put an object into it.
content: Before moving an object into a cabinet, check if the cabinet is closed and open it if necessary. Once the cabinet is open, use the move action to place the object inside.
